About this Event

Third Street Celebrates Community
Diwali Sparks at Third Street:
A Family Celebration of Dance & Henna
Featuring:
Henna art by Afreenz, Thuya, and Amoha
Dance Workshop featuring Ajna Dance Company

Sunday, November 8
12:45pm - Henna booths open
2pm - Interactive dance performance by Ajna Dance Company /Anna-Maria Kellen Concert Hall at Third StreetThis celebration is open to families, neighbors, and friends of all ages and abilities.

Celebrate Diwali – The Festival of Lights with Third Street Music School!
Celebrate Diwali with your loved ones at the Third Street Diwali Festival, a vibrant, family-friendly afternoon of art, rhythm, and community that brings the magic of the Festival of Lights to life through immersive cultural traditions. 
Observed by millions of people across India and the global South Asian diaspora, Diwali is a major five-day autumn festival symbolizing the spiritual victory of light over darkness, good over evil, and knowledge over ignorance. 
This joyful neighborhood gathering offers something special for children and adults alike, beginning in our outdoor courtyard transformed into a bustling oasis of artistic design where you can visit the booths of incredible local artists—Afreenz, Thuya, and Amoha—to get your own stunning, intricate henna patterns drawn. 
You can also get ready to move with an interactive dance workshop featuring New York’s premier South Asian performing arts organization, the Ajna Dance Company, known for blending classical Indian styles with high-energy Bollywood and Bhangra rhythms. Their professional teaching artists will have parents and kids grooving together.
